script: Rival kings invented a scandal to destroy Catherine the Great, and it worked for over two centuries. She seized power in a coup and expanded Russia's borders further than any ruler before her. Threatened European rulers could not defeat her armies, so they attacked her reputation instead. They spread a story that she died in a shocking, humiliating way, a story with no evidence behind it at all. The real Catherine woke before dawn, brewed her own coffee, and reformed Russia's entire legal system by candlelight. She collapsed from a stroke in her own palace, and died quietly in her bed the next day. But the invented scandal was more entertaining than the truth, so it spread through gossip, then books, then textbooks that never checked the facts. Rival kings invented a scandal to destroy her, and two hundred years later, most people still believe it.
